findings.title: Profile bio rendered unescaped with th:utext
findings.sink: th:utext rendering of rich-text fields (no shared HTML sanitizer)
findings.description: The public profile page renders the user's bio with th:utext. Any user can put markup in their bio that runs script for everyone who views their profile, including administrators.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled globally
findings.description: SecurityConfig disables CSRF protection for all routes with http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable()), introduced in commit 9f3d2b1 "disable csrf for mobile app". Browser sessions for grade submission and enrollment changes are exposed to cross-site request forgery.

findings.title: Open redirect after login via redirect parameter
findings.description: After login the handler redirects to the redirect query parameter without checking the host, so crafted login links can send students to a look-alike site.

findings.title: SMTP password committed in production config
findings.description: application-prod.yml contains the production SMTP account password in plain text (value redacted in this report). Anyone with repository access can send email as the platform.

findings.cweName: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
findings.title: No size limit on assignment uploads
findings.description: spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size is set to -1 and the controller streams uploads to disk without a quota, so a single user can fill the shared volume.

findings.title: Sessions stay valid for 30 days
findings.description: server.servlet.session.timeout is set to 30d, so sessions on shared lab computers stay valid for weeks.
